authorityBoundary.policy: Unsupported or incompletely identified gauges remain static; no command, MSL altitude, true heading, or default zero is relabeled as a missing measured quantity.

supported.label: IAS / KNOTS
supported.authority: Positively labeled IAS/KNOTS face driven by calibrated airspeed.
supported.calibration: Piecewise source-face marks through the normal C172 operating range; no generic 270-degree gauge formula.

supported.label: Principal VERTICAL SPEED
supported.authority: Positively labeled VERTICAL SPEED / 1000 FPM face driven by the filtered authoritative air-data state.
supported.calibration: Audited zero-at-left split scale: climb uses the upper arc and descent uses the lower arc at 0.5/1/2/4/6 thousand FPM.

exclusions.reason: Toe-brake command exists, but measured brake-system pressure does not. A control command is not presented as hydraulic pressure.
Ambiguous fantasy/reused faces; not a positively identified airspeed target.
Duplicate fantasy presentation; only the principal labeled VSI is dynamic.
Altitude is authoritative, but only one hand is separable while the counter/drum geometry remains static. Partial animation would be misleading.
Deterministic scenario UTC authority now exists, but the clock-hand topology and calibration are not proven; the represented clock remains static.
Only flap command is authoritative; actual flap-position feedback is unavailable.
Ambiguous fantasy face with no authoritative localizer/gyro presentation contract.
The card is identity-audited and heading is authoritative, but the fixed lubber vector and absolute authored-card registration are not proven. An arbitrary first-sample offset would be misleading.
Geometry is separate, but magnetic variation/heading is unavailable; true heading is not relabeled as magnetic heading.
Pitch/bank state exists, but the combined lower atlas/card topology is not deterministically separable without damaging unrelated panel art.

exclusions.item: Fuel, oil, tachometer and unlabeled faces
exclusions.reason: No positive face identity plus authoritative value pairing was proven.
